map.为文字叠加大量组合字符生成 Zalgo 乱码风格效果，可调节紊乱强度，用于恶搞表: Overlay many combining characters on text to produce a Zalgo glitch-style effect; adjust the chaos intensity for meme expressions, title decoration, and rendering tests.
map.实际上/中/下附加数上限 = 设定上限 × 强度 / 2；每个字符附加符号数 ~: Effective upper limits for above/mid/below attachments = set limit × intensity / 2; per-character attachment count ~ discrete uniform U{0, ⌊limit⌋} (upper, middle, lower groups sampled independently)
map.附加符号是 Unicode 组合标记（Combining Marks），它不增加: Attachment symbols are Unicode combining marks; they do not increase the character count but stack the rendered height, so string length changes little while the visual "spikes" are obvious. Intensity is a global multiplier that scales the effect without changing the three tier limits. The limit is scaled by intensity then floored, so at low intensity (e.g. 1) the actual attachment count is far below the set limit. Too many combining marks cause runaway line height and may not render after copy-paste in some fonts; for social platforms keep intensity at medium or below.
map.故障艺术装饰：在文字上叠加大量组合字符制造「撕裂/杂乱」观感，用于恐怖或实验风标: Glitch-art decoration: stack many combining marks on text for a 'torn/messy' look, used in horror or experimental titles.
map.社媒特效：做吸引眼球的昵称或文案点缀。: Social-media effects: eye-catching nicknames or copy accents.
map.视觉测试：检验渲染对组合字符的容错。: Visual testing: check rendering tolerance for combining characters.

map.为什么太强会读不出？: Why does too much intensity become unreadable?
map.Zalgo 靠叠加大量组合标记（U+0300+），强度越高字符越「膨胀」，屏幕宽: Zalgo stacks many combining marks (U+0300+); higher intensity makes characters 'swell', sharply reducing screen width and readability—use medium-low intensity for decoration.
map.会影响无障碍与搜索吗？: Does it affect accessibility and search?
map.会。屏幕阅读器可能逐读组合字符、搜索引擎难索引，正式内容慎用；仅限娱乐展示场景。: Yes. Screen readers may read combining marks one by one and search engines struggle to index them; avoid in formal content—use only for entertainment.
